ranking_basis: Root ordinal research-priority judgment considering cell relevance, functional evidence, reproducibility, toxicity and access; not an efficacy score or cross-study pooled ranking

ranked_candidates.name: 2-fluorophenyl gluconamide (2FA)
ranked_candidates.proposed_role: Physical arm for initial iPSC qualification, followed by neuronal confirmation
ranked_candidates.evidence_quality_and_function: Direct splat IRI assay; neuronal yield and longitudinal MEA readouts
ranked_candidates.toxicity_and_mechanistic_limits: No direct cell-death-target evidence; doses show nonmonotonic effects
ranked_candidates.reproducibility: Named structure/dose series available; recovery co-treatment and comparator labels need reconciliation
ranked_candidates.transfer_limits: One neuronal donor context/two differentiations; limited generalization
ranked_candidates.next_gate: Literature reconciliation and material identity/lot check before assay

ranked_candidates.name: CEPT recovery cocktail
ranked_candidates.proposed_role: Biological recovery factor; compare against a defined standard recovery treatment
ranked_candidates.evidence_quality_and_function: Multi-line hPSC viability and differentiated-cell outcomes
ranked_candidates.toxicity_and_mechanistic_limits: No direct ice inhibition established; motor-neuron day-7 MEA p=0.5023 does not show significant superiority
ranked_candidates.reproducibility: Component doses reported, including commercial polyamine stock dilution; hold background treatment explicit
ranked_candidates.transfer_limits: Different lineages/timings; cocktail is not a single dual-action molecule
ranked_candidates.next_gate: Confirm formulation, exposure/washout and lineage tolerability

ranked_candidates.name: THP-1 polyampholyte formulation
ranked_candidates.proposed_role: Physical-mechanism reference and candidate for later cell-domain transfer
ranked_candidates.evidence_quality_and_function: Delayed recovery, direct intracellular-ice imaging and macrophage-like differentiation markers
ranked_candidates.toxicity_and_mechanistic_limits: No pathway-target proof; five-cell Raman sample and THP-1 line do not establish donor-level efficacy
ranked_candidates.reproducibility: Synthesis and 40 mg/mL formulation reported; polymer charge/lot and separate pollen-nucleator factor matter
ranked_candidates.transfer_limits: One leukemia line; about 24-hour frozen storage; no iPSC result
ranked_candidates.next_gate: Characterize polymer and reproduce physical/THP-1 benchmark first

ranked_candidates.name: Ethylene glycol plus trehalose
ranked_candidates.proposed_role: DMSO-free formulation comparator once complete handling is available
ranked_candidates.evidence_quality_and_function: iPSC microsphere viability/pluripotency in abstract; supplement confirms composition and apoptosis contrasts
ranked_candidates.toxicity_and_mechanistic_limits: Incubation caspase and post-freeze TUNEL are distinct; cluster/age and crosslinking injury confound transfer
ranked_candidates.reproducibility: 12% v/v EG plus 4% w/v trehalose verified in supplement; main loading/thermal methods unavailable
ranked_candidates.transfer_limits: Missing main text and iPSC donor details
ranked_candidates.next_gate: Obtain main methods before laboratory protocol finalization

ranked_candidates.name: CAMP adhesion-preserving bioink
ranked_candidates.proposed_role: Mechanistic material track, separate from single-molecule discovery
ranked_candidates.evidence_quality_and_function: Ice-grain assay and FAK-inhibitor perturbation; preserved adhesion
ranked_candidates.toxicity_and_mechanistic_limits: Material effects, inhibitor toxicity and physical injury need matching; live fractions are not absolute yield
ranked_candidates.reproducibility: Main methods available; microcarrier/matrix manufacture and lot specifications required
ranked_candidates.transfer_limits: MSC/HUVEC/C2C12 transfer; short cryostorage; omics labels need clarification
ranked_candidates.next_gate: Validate matrix/carrier-only controls and material reproducibility

ranked_candidates.name: Polaribacter recombinant CspB
ranked_candidates.proposed_role: Dual-axis mechanistic reference for oocytes, not immediate iPSC drug lead
ranked_candidates.evidence_quality_and_function: Physical ice assay and mTOR-activator reversal of injury markers
ranked_candidates.toxicity_and_mechanistic_limits: No direct protein-mTOR binding; still requires ethylene glycol
ranked_candidates.reproducibility: Reported 21.9 kDa construct; sequence/tag/purity and kit schedule need confirmation
ranked_candidates.transfer_limits: Animal oocyte/parthenogenetic endpoints; no iPSC/offspring efficacy
ranked_candidates.next_gate: Resolve protein identity and physical-damage-matched controls

deferred_candidates.name: L-PTAA enzymatic peptide oligomer
deferred_candidates.reason: Sequence-specific IRI but only 34% hemolysis-derived sheep RBC recovery at the reported optimum; no nucleated-cell function or direct biological mechanism.

deferred_candidates.name: Amino-acid trehalose diesters
deferred_candidates.reason: Abstract-only; acellular radical scavenging and favorable compatibility coexist with lower recovery than 10 wt% DMSO. Exact dosing/handling and cryo-model allocation unresolved.

deferred_candidates.name: Berberine/melatonin plus Fe3O4/AFP embryo protocol
deferred_candidates.reason: Useful sequential-control example, but not a proven synergy benchmark; arithmetic/column clarification and replicate data needed, with substantial animal-embryo transfer limits.

novelty_status: Known literature candidates and proposed combinations; no novel compound, patent clearance, therapeutic efficacy or prospective validation established
